# NMS-API sample

`notams_sample.json` is a small, hand-picked sample of real responses from the NMS-API **staging (pre-production) environment**, captured 2026-11-22 with `nmsResponseFormat: GEOJSON`. Records were chosen to cover the shapes the parser must handle (permanent, cancelled, missing type, schedules, odd altitude limits, polygons and multi-polygons, single-translation records). Staging data may include test or cutover entries; it is not an operational source.

Provided as is, with no warranty. A best-effort copy; not FAA data as published and not endorsed by the FAA.
